import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from offline_discovery.rule_remove import exact_key_count, attach_hits, score_clusters
rng=random.Random(3)
L=16
clusters=[]
for i in range(2048):
    base=1515+(i%20)
    clusters.append({'id':i*2,'class':0,'members':[i*2,i*2+1],'core':[i*2,i*2+1],
                     'length':L,'range':[[base,base+3] for _ in range(L)]})
validation=[{'class':0,'values':[1515+rng.randrange(40) for _ in range(128)]} for _ in range(200)]
attach_hits(clusters, validation, 1)
kept=score_clusters(clusters, validation, 1, (0,1))
print('kept', len(kept))
for cap in (0, 1, 5, 100, 8192):
    start=time.time()
    print('cap',cap,'entries',exact_key_count(kept,cap),'%.3fs'%(time.time()-start))
# pathological overlapping unions
cases = {
 'overlap-2d': ([{'length':2,'range':[[0,0],[i,i+4000]]} for i in range(4096)], 8192),
 'overlap-2d-b': ([{'length':2,'range':[[i%7,i%7],[i,i+4000]]} for i in range(4096)], 8192),
 'nested-3d': ([{'length':3,'range':[[0,1],[i%4,i%4+1],[0,2]]} for i in range(4096)], 8192),
 'grid': ([{'length':2,'range':[[i//64, i//64],[i%64, i%64]]} for i in range(4096)], 8192),
 'chain': ([{'length':3,'range':[[i, i],[0,3000],[0,3000]]} for i in range(200)], 8192),
 'wide': ([{'length':2,'range':[[0,3000],[0,3000]]}], 8192),
 'many-identical': ([{'length':2,'range':[[5,9],[7,11]]} for i in range(4096)], 8192),
 'tight-overlap': ([{'length':2,'range':[[0,0],[i,i+8193]]} for i in range(4096)], 8192),
}
for name,(cls,cap) in cases.items():
    start=time.time()
    print('%-16s entries=%-8d %.3fs' % (name, exact_key_count(cls,cap), time.time()-start))
PYEOF
